positiveTruth: one translation containing at least one adjudicated major or critical meaning error
primaryWarning: at least one semantic_issues item with severity major or critical OR at least one uncertainty
majorCriticalQuoteNotFound: preserve the warning as whole-paragraph risk; do not invent a red span
minorOnly: retain in diagnostic evidence; not a material-risk warning
languageNotesOnly: retain in diagnostic evidence; not a material-risk warning or an automatic correction
invalidQuoteInMinorOrLanguageNoteOnly: record localization failure; do not infer a material meaning error from it
invalidOrMissingResponse: not completed or no_findings; count positive truth as FN and block acceptance for incomplete coverage
secondaryMajorCriticalOnly: report separately; cannot replace the primary acceptance gate
acceptancePolicy: product-qe-95-v2; overall and each system/split/cross-split must have recall and precision >= 0.95, with all six required known errors detected
redSpanEligibility: only major/critical semantic assertions with exact validated target quotes; actual semantic span precision still requires independent source-grounded evaluation
quoteLocalizationDenominator: retain all submitted nonempty quotes including minor and language-note quotes; report collection and severity separately
reasonForNewVersion: The first three v1 smoke responses included a risk warning on a non-material-error paragraph solely because a fluency-note quote was not an exact match. A diagnostic localization failure is not evidence of a major meaning error. The product risk action is now explicitly aligned with the pre-existing major/critical positive-truth definition.
observationsBeforeThisPolicy: Qwen v3 first three Hy7 dev responses and their existing labels; no Qwen response from the remaining 45 inputs observed
